leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply variable scope rules to control data accessibility in different code blocks
Construct functions that demonstrate lexical scope and closure behavior
Manipulate variable declarations to observe hoisting effects in execution
Initialize variables within the Temporal Dead Zone to trigger reference errors
Configure code examples that differentiate between var, let, and const hoisting
Implement practical solutions to avoid common scope-related bugs
Update existing code to resolve Temporal Dead Zone issues
